state: WRITTEN all-variable normal-factor reduction and candidate universal PSD4 bound; UNREVIEWED. No selected diagnostic or physical q-value evaluated.
exact_block_reduction: For normal A=diag(a1,…,a4), arbitrary traceless B and any common site-2 unitary V, H=X†X is ⊕ H_i(V), H_i=V(B+a_iI)†(B+a_iI)V†. The 120×120 compound modulus splits exactly into four |H_i^[2]| blocks (6×6 each) and six cross blocks |H_i|⊗I+I⊗|H_j| (16×16 each). Thus its spectral radius is max{max_i ρ(|H_i^[2]|), max_{i<j}[ρ(|H_i|)+ρ(|H_j|)]}. Minimizing only over V provides an upper bound on η; failure in this restricted A-diagonal basis is NOT failure of the fully optimized η.
candidate_psd4_lemma: For every 4×4 Hermitian PSD H, ρ(|H^[2]|)≤(3/2)Tr H, sharp. For H=uu†, R=J_+†(|u||u|^T⊗I+I⊗|u||u|^T)J_+. A Perron vector defines a REAL symmetric zero-diagonal W with ||W||F=1, and its Rayleigh quotient is 2||W|u|||²≤(3/2)||u||² since W is traceless symmetric and ||W||op²≤3||W||F²/4. Extend by the spectral decomposition of H, entrywise triangle and λmax subadditivity. Auxiliary PSD matrices are not physical q-target evaluations.
resulting_sufficient_test: Put a=||A||F²,b=||B||F²,L=a+b,t_i=b+4|a_i|², h_i=||H_i||F. Since ρ(|H_i|)≤h_i and ρ(|H_i^[2]|)≤min{(3/2)t_i,2h_i}, η≤2L whenever max_i min{(3/2)t_i,2h_i}≤2L and max_{i<j}(h_i+h_j)≤2L. In particular all normal tracezero A with equal eigenvalue moduli satisfy η≤2L for arbitrary traceless B in every B basis; this is not the full proposed one-normal theorem.
